DHL Express

# Building the world's largest commercial document archive

We searched the world for a suitable solution for our document management and the answer was right in front of us all along – just across the Rhine river at Doxis.

Martin Treder, Global IT

![Logo of DHL Express](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/3/DHL-express-logo-recatangle-hnqgs22fhvd17xn.png)

![](https://www.doxis.com/assets/images/j/20181025_CU_DHL-1cycrynthn1gsdk.jpg)

## DHL Express at a glance

- Founded: 1969
- Headquarters: Bonn, Germany
- Employees: 77,000
- Core industry: Logistics

### Challenges

- The old, decentralized systems did not offer consistent access to electronic documents
- High, uncertain operating costs and limited functional extendibility
- No guaranteed performance or response times
- Different solutions for long-term and short-term archiving

### Solutions

- DHL “Global Imaging Archive (GIA)” based on Doxis
- Long-term archiving for documents with retention obligations
- Scalable document volumes, functionality and number of users
- Global availability for users throughout the world
